name: option-universe-300-rank
notes: ADR-0235: choose the next 300 optionable US stocks by total option-contract volume over the last 20 sessions, excluding the 117 already pulled. Reads the chain_volume stream acquired through configs/source-option-activity.json, ranks with TrailingRank, and writes configs/option_universe_300.json (ordered `tickers` plus the `ranking` rows with their 20-session volume). The pull config symbols come from that file, never typed. Run from children/index_options after the activity acquisition: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-option-universe-300-rank.json --asof 2026-10-03. The writer refuses to overwrite: move the old file first or set overwrite.

chain_volume.notes: Per-underlying, per-session total option volume (and count of contracts that traded) from the activity pull. A symbol missing from a session did not trade that day. The root is the machine store root (the established convention for onboarding store paths in these configs); change it per machine.

rank.notes: window must equal the sessions the activity pull totalled (20); the node refuses a shorter history. The exclusion list is the 117-stock universe already pulled (stock_universe.json), read from its file so it is stated once. require_top_n turns a thin candidate pool into a refusal rather than a short universe. exclude lists tickers the name filter missed (DXYZ is a closed-end fund that read as a company); it adds to the file exclusions.

params.source: TrailingRank over 20 sessions of chain_volume (option-activity), top 300 excluding stock_universe.json

universe_file.notes: expect counts the two top-level entries, tickers and ranking. The pull source config reads `tickers` from this file.
